title: Baylan Skoll
subtitle: Independent
description: Baylan Skoll was a Lightsaber-wielding mercenary for hire. Though not a Jedi, there was a time when Skoll knew the acclaimed Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker. Skoll works in tandem with his apprentice, Shin Hati, serving Morgan Elsbeth in her hunt for Grand Admiral Thrawn.
